{{Quote|Sergeant Remolo. Message back to the admiral. Guarded channels.|Hondo Karr, to Remolo|<ref name="Legacy 21" />}}
'''Remolo''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]] in [[137 ABY]]. The sergeant was part of an [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|Alliance]] team led by [[Hondo Karr]] that hijacked the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']]. After the hijacking, Karr directed Remolo to send a secure communication to Stazi.<ref name="Legacy 21" />

==Behind the scenes==
Remolo is addressed as present but not visually depicted in [[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]].<ref name="Legacy 21" />
